title: RBI Amends UCB Deposit Interest Rate Disclosure Rules from October 1, 2026
description: RBI's Second Amendment Directions, 2026 require UCBs to disclose deposit and bulk deposit interest rates on their websites and maintain uniform rates from 1 October 2026.The post RBI Amends UCB Deposit Interest Rate Disclosure Rules from October 1, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
